admission.justification: The bundled hash-pinned catalog, isolated lazy AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE with read/write asymmetry, local-only languages.json and custom library overrides, active LanguageSet cache-key isolation, declarative tags.scm/tests.scm extraction, and .lean reservation together guarantee uniform language-agnostic anchor resolution across every production consumer without privileged grammar dependencies or cross-set cache leakage.

guarantee: Every tree-sitter citation consumer resolves source bindings and JS/TS test-case call sites declaratively through the active or repository-scoped LanguageSet ContextVar backed by the bundled hash-pinned language_catalog.lock.json (19 pypi_wheel including 15 core pilots, 56 tree-sitter-language-pack entries with honest guaranteeTier, and builtin_lean), isolated lazy AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE wheel and direct pack-binding loading with full-catalog warm --all, engine-side parent and leading-sibling wrapper widening, declarative per-language QualifierSpec resolution or honest refusal, and local-only languages.json/custom-library overrides; derives extractor identity from pinned versions, binaries, query digests, and non-default policy across all downstream caches; preserves read-degrade versus write-refuse failure asymmetry; and keeps .lean permanently reserved for the built-in Lean declaration scanner.
title: Uniform language catalog, lazy cache, and declarative LanguageSet seam
